title: private-deploy-field-notes-nyc-42b-scratchpad-2026-03-04
content:
Context: onsite kickoff with NYC-42B (healthcare customer). Private deployment (VPC + on-prem gateway). Quick scratchpad for steps, blockers, env specifics and follow-ups. Informal notes - not final.

Goals for this visit:
- Validate install runbook for on-prem gateway behind customer firewall
- Smoke test inference with small load (v1 config) and KV cache persistence
- Confirm KMS integration and audit log delivery to customer's SIEM
- Identify network gaps (eg. egress rules, MTU, proxy auth)

High-level environment notes (customer-provided):
- VPC: us-east-1-equivalent (private subnet A/B), managed by customer infra team
- Firewall: Palo Alto (explicit allow list required)
- Proxy: outbound through corp proxy (requires NTLM auth)
- KMS: on-prem HSM reachable via IP 10.10.8.12:1800 (tunneled over bastion)
- Storage: NFS mount for model artifacts at 10.10.9.4:/redwood-models

Install steps (working, sequential):
1) Pre-checks (do before maintenance window)
   - Confirm network ACLs allow 443 to registry.redwood.ai and S3 endpoints (or provide S3 mirror). TODO: get list of CIDRs from infra.
   - Verify bastion access and that port 1800 is reachable for HSM through tunnel.
   - Ensure NFS mount reachable, disk I/O > 200MB/s (customer metric)
   - Collect proxy creds from SecOps; test curl via proxy: curl -x http://proxy:3128 -U user:pass https://registry.redwood.ai/health

2) Provision hosts & dependencies
   - VM flavors: 4x r6g.8xlarge (CPU warmers), 2x g5.12xlarge for GPU (quantized models)
   - Attach IAM role equivalent (we use customer-managed robot account)
   - Mount NFS at /mnt/redwood-models and chown redwood:redwood

3) Gateway install
   - Use private-deploy scripts (refer PR#78). Run: ./deploy/gateway/install.sh --env nyc-42b --skip-cert
   - For initial run set --dry-run false only when NFS verified
   - Configure service to use proxy wrapper if NTLM required (wrap with cntlm)

4) KMS/HSM
   - Confirm HSM connection via stunnel from gateway host to 10.10.8.12:1800
   - Test keywrap using redwood-cli: redwood kms test --endpoint https://10.10.8.12:1800 --key-id test-key
   - Blocker: customer HSM requires mutual TLS; need client cert from SecOps (not provided yet)

5) Network & Firewall
   - Required egress: registry.redwood.ai:443, metrics.redwood.ai:443, s3.*:443 (or mirror)
   - If strict allow-list, provide IP ranges. Action: ask NetOps for IP ranges by EOD.

6) Smoke tests
   - Start minimal services: gateway, model-server (quantized-1.0) with batch_size=1
   - Run 100 short inference requests (prompt length 32) and collect latency and error rate
   - Verify KV cache persistence survives restart: generate token stream, restart model-server, resume and check KV cache hit

Known blockers / open items
- HSM mutual TLS certs (SecOps to provide) - BLOCKER for production KMS.
- Proxy NTLM creds scope: need long-lived service account or wrapper; currently using quick-test creds.
- NFS performance: customer observed spikes during backups - schedule install outside backup window.
- Firewall IP ranges: NetOps needs to confirm; until then we cannot finalize egress rules.
- Audit log forwarder: GRAYLOG endpoint credentials pending (Ticket PD-4321)

Quick commands & snippets
- Test registry reachability:
  curl -v --proxy http://proxy:3128 --proxy-user user:pass https://registry.redwood.ai/health

- Mount NFS:
  sudo mount -t nfs 10.10.9.4:/redwood-models /mnt/redwood-models

- Run gateway install (local):
  ./deploy/gateway/install.sh --env nyc-42b --nfs /mnt/redwood-models --kms-endpoint https://10.10.8.12:1800

Post-visit follow-ups (assignments)
- Alex: chase SecOps for HSM client cert + expiry window (PD-4321). Due: 2026-03-06
- Jordan: prepare ip-range list and firewall note for NetOps (include registry + S3 mirrors). Due: 2026-03-05
- Priya: convert these notes into the install-runbook PR and link to PR#78. Due: 2026-03-07

Notes to self / rough ideas
- Consider offering a lightweight S3 mirror container people can run on-prem to avoid opening broad S3 CIDRs.
- Evaluate using local KMS shim that proxies to HSM to simplify mutual TLS requirement for services.
- Add a small troubleshooting checklist for common proxy auth failures (401 vs NTLM handshake issues).

References / tickets
- Confluence runbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/PD/Private+Deployments+Checklist
- Jira: PD-4321 (audit log + HSM certs)
- Install scripts PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/private-deploy-scripts/pull/78

End of scratchpad (will clean up and convert to formal runbook after on-site).
